answer.rationale: The two measured declines this quarter are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and those are causally linked: memory_86 says shortening onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value, and memory_31/memory_91 say the downstream activation effects follow. Fixing the funnel step that is actually degrading is the intervention most aligned with sustainable long-term qualified revenue, and it compounds rather than buying a one-quarter number. I am verifying memory_86 because it is the direct basis for my chosen action and I want to confirm the effect was measured on completion AND retained value, not just completion, and that the baseline population resembles today's self-serve mix. I am verifying memory_73 because promotional_pricing is the obvious reflex against a competitor's entry pricing and it is the memory I trust least on the dimension that matters: it reports trial starts +31% and quarterly revenue +18% on small accounts over 12 weeks, which is a window long enough to capture acquisition but not long enough to capture discount-cohort retention, margin erosion, or whether those accounts ever became qualified revenue. A 12-week revenue lift on discounted small accounts is exactly the shape of a result that looks strong and decays; if the archive shows no retention or LTV instrumentation, that memory should not drive a decision under an explicitly long-term objective. Discounting into a competitor's price war also resets our own price anchor durably, which is hard to unwind. Not chosen this week: referral_incentive (memory_57 is about established customers and does not address a top-of-funnel activation drop), enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44 is credible but targets a segment that is not the one bleeding). Downstream value risk on my own pick: simplifying signup by cutting required fields can improve activation while degrading lead qualification data and routing quality, so the apparent win can hide a loss in qualified revenue. I will therefore instrument qualified-pipeline-per-signup and 60-day retention as guardrails, not just completion and activation, and hold the memory-based lift as a prior to be re-measured rather than an established fact, since all six memories are consolidated summaries whose original conditions may differ from a quarter with active competitive pressure.
